detectors.fcu_boot_reset: MAVLink SYSTEM_TIME (message 2) time_boot_ms decreases by more than 1000 ms within a processed sequence
detectors.transport_reconnect: MAVROS state field.connected transitions from 0 to 1
detectors.large_gap: timestamp gap exceeds max(fixed minimum, 10 times the within-sequence median interval)

development_decision.reason: ALFA observes the Pixhawk/MAVLink source and selected ROS processed clips, not the semantic receiver process, its codebook catalog, or its volatile action cache.

claim_boundary: Processed clips from the same raw flight were not treated as independent.
No confirmation processed value or raw bag payload was opened.
A detected FCU boot reset would still not equal a semantic receiver-context reset.
A zero event count cannot be generalized beyond the detector coverage and selected clips.
